name: Pipeline health watchdog + dashboard parser fixes
goal: Two deliverables: (1) pipeline-watchdog.ts: standalone script that checks if scs001-pipeline wrote to publish-ledger.jsonl in the last 4h. If stale, sends Telegram alert to OWNER. Runs via PM2 cron every 30 minutes. Eliminates silent pipeline failures before the Apr 7 gate. (2) Commit pre-existing improvements to dashboard/parsers/assets.py and dashboard/parsers/logs.py (autonomous session log support + kognai crystallised skills reader).
rationale: Apr 7 gate: 0/30 posts, ~22 days. scs001-pipeline cron runs 4x/day — if it silently fails (memory OOM, qwen3 timeout, etc), operator won't know for hours. Watchdog fires 30min after a scheduled slot if ledger hasn't been updated. assets.py + logs.py improvements were already coded but uncommitted — clean them up.
swarm: NOT USED — 1 new script + 1 config edit + commit unstaged files. Direct write.

tasks.title: scripts/pipeline-watchdog.ts — pipeline staleness detector
tasks.description:
Standalone script following daily-digest.ts pattern. Reads workspace/scs001/publish-ledger.jsonl — finds most recent published_at timestamp. If no file or empty: ledger is stale. staleHours = (now - lastPublished) / 3600000. STALE_THRESHOLD_HOURS = 4. WATCHDOG_DRY_RUN env = skip send. If staleHours >= STALE_THRESHOLD_HOURS: send Telegram alert '⚠️ SCS-001 Pipeline Stale
Last ledger entry: Xh ago
Check PM2: pm2 logs scs001-pipeline
Gate: Y/30 posts, Z days to Apr 7'. Read manual-posts.jsonl for post count. If not stale: exit 0 silently (no message). Send via HTTPS to Telegram API (same pattern as daily-digest.ts).
